cross_program_language_comparison.interpretation: Measured geometry descriptors; visual review remains required.

visual_design_review.review_basis: Direct inspection of the three original-resolution 20-mass PNG boards and the 60-mass combined board.

neighborhood.improvement: Four seed/formal families are represented and numeric near-duplicate pairs remain zero.
neighborhood.failure: Elongated street bars and stepped or folded terrace cascades still dominate; cells 04/08/10/16/19 and 02/06/13/18 retain strong family resemblance.

gymnasium.improvement: Ridge, folded, sawtooth/daylight-monitor, stepped-section and carved-entry relations now appear as real roof/section geometry, and all six BOOK scopes are represented.
gymnasium.failure: The portfolio still repeats a low rectangular long-span hall chassis; cells 02/06, 03/13 and 05/10/15 read as close footprint/roof families despite sectional modifiers.

cultural.improvement: Court-bridge, split-gallery-ramp and carved-gallery-spine families all survive the real projection and program hard gates.
cultural.failure: Low stepped gallery bars and compact stacked boxes remain repetitive; cells 02/05/06/07/10/14/17 and 09/13/18/19/20 show strong family resemblance.

visual_design_review.verdict: Compiler, clean-mass and program diagnostics pass, but the 60-mass set is not yet architectural competition grade.
